dialogues.speaker: Dahlia
dialogues.text: ...So that guest from Natlan inspired your new hymn?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: I was practicing outside the city, and had just finished a high note, when I saw a fluffy tail drooping from a tree...

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: For a moment, I thought I'd seen a wild beast... But upon closer inspection, it was just Miss Xilonen from Natlan.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wasn't Xilonen taking naps in the library before? Why'd she switch back to trees again...

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Well, she said she was worried about disturbing others by sleeping in the library, so she wanted to find a more deserted spot... But in the end, I guess she ended up being the one who was disturbed instead.

response.speaker: Dahlia
response.text: Oh, don't you worry, Miss Barbara. I doubt your voice could ever "disturb" anyone. Why else would she have helped you adjust the rhythm of that hymn to the Anemo Archon?

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: She's just... so nice! Even though she was yawning the whole time, she gave me tons of useful suggestions!

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: It's just a shame we don't have a "Dance-Off Stage" in Mondstadt. Then we could use it to test those instruments she was talking about...

choices.text: We should take a trip to Natlan together.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Really? That's wonderful. I haven't visited other nations much up till now...

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: But before that, let me polish off this new hymn to the Anemo Archon. I shouldn't waste all the help Miss Xilonen and that bard Venti have given me.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, remember to come listen to me sing. You too, Dahlia!

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: Hmm, and Venti as well, I guess. As long as he hasn't had too much to drink...

response.speaker: Dahlia
response.text: That won't be a problem. I'm sure Venti rates your songs more highly than any old fine wine.

response.speaker: Barbara
response.text: But I almost never see him without a bottle in his hand... *sigh* May the Anemo Archon watch over him. He has such talent... If only he'd put it to better use.

response.speaker: Dahlia
response.text: The way I see it, the Anemo Archon does look out for him. Out of all of my friends, he's one of the freest people I know.

response.speaker: Dahlia
response.text: Anyway, it's almost time for confession. If you'll excuse me...

response.speaker: Dahlia
response.text: Well, Cardinal Seamus is back at the Cathedral, as you might have heard. It's not every day that an opportunity to confess to him comes around. Wouldn't miss it for the world.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Cardinal Seamus... Oh, right! He's that "Cardinal of Daybreak" guy Varka was talking about, the one who went with him on his expedition to Nod-Krai!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon heard that the expedition members were heading back to Mondstadt, but she didn't expect them to be back so soon.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: But, unless I'm remembering this wrong, he's also...

choices.text: You can try the Dance-Off Stage for yourself.
Another one of her outdoor afternoon naps, huh...
